description: Holaaa somos Astro-Mecanos, un equipo apasionado por la ingeniería, la resolución de problemas y la exploración espacial. Nos estamos preparando para el reto de identificar ubicaciones análogas en la Tierra para misiones en la Luna y Marte. Buscamos integrar mentes creativas y entusiastas para armar una propuesta sólida e innovadora para este reto. ¡Únete a nuestro equipo y hagamos que este proyecto despegue!
summary: A website was developed containing relevant information about the Atacama Desert in Chile, which is considered a highly important analog environment for the Moon and, primarily, Mars, due to its comparable environmental and geological conditions. This makes it a strategic location for research and the development of future bases, landing sites, and technological equipment testing on Earth, allowing researchers to simulate extreme conditions and reduce error margins in future space missions.
details:
The project consists of developing an informative and educational website entitled “Astro-Mecanos: From One Desert to Another World – Atacama–Mars Explorer”, whose purpose is to present relevant information about the Atacama Desert, located in Chile, and explore its relationship with the planet Mars. Through this digital platform, the aim is to provide information in an organized, attractive, and accessible way, allowing users to learn about the geographical and environmental characteristics of this desert, as well as understand why its natural conditions make it an important location for scientific research and space exploration.

The website works by presenting informative content through visual resources and graphic elements that facilitate understanding of the topics covered. Its main benefit is to provide a digital platform for accessing information about the Atacama Desert and its scientific importance, encouraging interest in astronomy, geography, and the exploration of other planets.

The expected impact of the project is to contribute to the dissemination of scientific and technological knowledge, promote independent learning, and generate interest in the relationship between our planet and outer space. Furthermore, it aims to demonstrate how digital tools can be used to communicate educational information in an innovative and understandable way for different types of users.

The Canva platform was used for its development, specifically its website design and creation tools, which made it possible to organize the information, incorporate images, texts, and graphic elements, and establish a visual structure that facilitates navigation. It was not necessary to implement programming languages or use specialized hardware, since the development was carried out using the digital tools provided by the platform.

The creativity of the project lies in the way it connects two seemingly different environments: the Atacama Desert and the planet Mars. This approach aims to present information from an exploration perspective, using a space-themed concept that makes the educational content more interesting and engaging.

Finally, several factors were considered during the development of the project, including the accuracy and relevance of the information, content organization, text clarity, image selection, color combinations, visual design, and ease of navigation. These aspects were essential to creating a functional, attractive, and easy-to-understand website that fulfills its informative and educational purpose.
